buyer: SmithKline Beecham Corporation (subsidiary of GlaxoSmithKline plc)

premium.basis: Announced premium over the$1.97 closing price on the last trading day before announcement, as cited in the dossier's rationale section.

value_inflection_events.event: Unidentified event causing significant price drop

leaked_early.details: No pre-deal rumors or press reports regarding a potential buyout were identified.

notes: GSK initially proposed $10M for the DirectSelect technology asset but was persuaded to acquire the whole company, which was facing a severe liquidity crisis, at a 150% premium in cash over a competing stock-for-stock bid.
